maddeler.e:
نعتلي (form VIII)
# نَعْتَلِي (naʕtalī) /naʕ.ta.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# نَعْتَلِيَ (naʕtaliya) /naʕ.ta.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
